summary: A better way of doing something can make you realize how much unnecessary difficulty you had started treating as normal.
body: A better way of doing something can make you realize how much unnecessary difficulty you had started treating as normal. When Saturn sextiles Uranus, structure and experimentation support each other, making it easier to introduce a new tool, boundary, routine, or method without destabilizing everything around it. The improvement does not have to be dramatic to change what you can rely on. If the new way saves time, removes friction, or gives you more room to move, stop assuming difficulty was part of the deal.
